藏品名称_EN: the bodhisattva guanyin holding a vase
描述_EN: compassionate guanyin has always been a favourite deity for chinese buddhists. in his left hand, guanyin holds a vase, said to relieve the thirst of his devotees. often known by the sanskrit name 'avalokitesvara', guanyin is said to have come from a ray of light emanating from the buddha amitabha. this typical representation shows him wearing a headdress incorporating the buddha amitabha, surrounded by a lotus halo (now damaged).
描述_ZN: 慈悲的观音菩萨一直是中国佛教徒喜爱的神灵。 他的左手拿着一个花瓶，据说是为了缓解信徒们的口渴。 通常以梵文名称 "阿瓦洛基斯瓦拉 "而闻名，据说观音来自于阿弥陀佛发出的一束光。 这幅典型的图画显示他戴着一个包含阿弥陀佛的头饰，周围有一个莲花光环（现已损坏）。
